title: Teamtailor roles
description: One row per open role, with every office of that role.

status.description: DELIVERED for a real role that was charged. Anything else names why the row is not a role and is free: NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_NOT_FOUND, NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_EMPTY, NOT_CHECKED_NO_MATCH, NOT_CHECKED_CAP, NOT_CHECKED_ERROR, INVALID_INPUT.

board.description: The board host the row came from, for example oatly.teamtailor.com or jobs.tibber.com.

jobId.description: Job id from the posting itself. One role is one row, even when it lists several offices.

title.description: Role title as the employer wrote it.

company.description: Hiring organisation name from the posting.

employmentType.description: Employment type as the feed writes it, for example FULL_TIME. Several values are joined with a comma.

directApply.description: True when the posting says it accepts a direct application.

remote.description: True when the posting is marked remote: jobLocationType TELECOMMUTE or applicant location requirements are present.

country.description: Country of the first office, as the feed writes it.

countryCode.description: Two letter country code of the first office, when the feed sends one.

postalCode.description: Postal code of the first office.

locations.description: Every office of this role, not only the first one. 15 of 109 live roles carried more than one, and each of them stays one row.

publishedAt.description: Publication date from the posting, ISO form.

validThrough.description: The date the posting says it is valid until, null when it says nothing. 9 of 109 live roles carried one.

description.description: Full description, html or text per descriptionFormat. Null when includeDetails is off.

reason.description: Why the row is not a role, for status rows.

delivered.description: True only for a row written and charged in one call.

billable.description: True when the price list carries our event for this run, false when billing is off, null when the price could not be read.
